# How much will the slow season cost you?

> Free seasonal sales forecaster for small shops and restaurants. Paste your monthly sales to get a 12-month forecast with ranges, your slow and peak months, a back-test against last year, and the cash cushion for the slow season. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
